Once I have that, I’ll look up the exact item IDs in your order and set up the exchange to:
- the **same mechanical keyboard model** with **clicky switches**

I have my order ID—it’s #W2378156. I’m afraid I don’t remember which email I used for the order. Is there another way to verify my account?
